root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before AddHasRoute() may copy one HasRouteEntry from the selected aHasRoute object, the selected Has Route TLV must contain at least one entry (`aHasRoute.GetNumEntries() > 0`). The vulnerable original reaches the protected memcpy with zero entries; the fixed original is guarded on the stock PoC, and the closest source-grounded witness `valid_hasroute_single_entry` executes the same selected copy with one entry present.
root_cause_criterion.description: The missing root obligation is the absent `aHasRoute.GetNumEntries() > 0` guard before the selected Has Route TLV is copied.

nodes.description: At the selected memcpy sink, the vulnerable original copies 3 bytes from a Has Route TLV whose value length is 0, so the copy width exceeds the available payload.

edges.relation: The exact selected HasRouteTlv::GetEntry(0) pointer recovered from the forwarded networkData span is the same source pointer later passed into the AddHasRoute() memcpy.
